method.freeze: Primary 0/10 body, 30/70 risk, 30-minute entry deadline, common original-reference 1.25R TP, original SL, no BE or early close. Frozen in commentary and plan before inspecting fresh qualified outcomes. Controls cannot replace primary based on fresh results.
method.qualification: Fresh-only dates requalified using unchanged runVolumeStudy M15 volume >=250 decrease, H4 structure and EMA20/50, H1 continuation/Far. All indicators use closed data at confirmation. Recent native OANDA M15/H1/H4 snapshots supply context.
method.execution: Same verified exhaustive OHLC event-order engine, new data replayed primarily at M1 and separately at M15. Stops/targets exact ideal levels, no spread, commission, slippage, swaps or gap execution costs. Missing and conflicting paths stay uncertain; open/unfilled outcomes excluded from resolved win rate.
method.timing: For closed legs, openedAt is first candle where every path confirms a fill; closedAt is first candle end where every path confirms closure. Exit cash flows grouped at that bar end. Holding durations use those bar timestamps.
method.risk: Fixed $4 total setup risk, no compounding, ideal fractional lots. Realized drawdown uses known closed-setup cash flows only, grouped by exit candle. It excludes floating losses and uncertain outcomes, and is not a live-account drawdown estimate. Consecutive losing counts refer to exit bars, not individual trade order within the same bar.
method.sizing: Current Exness XAUUSDm contract100 oz, .01 minimum and step checked independently. Two-leg split may be impossible at $200 balance and 2% risk. No risk increase to force orders.
method.limitations: Fresh period is only about 2.5 days and may contain very few independent setups. It was not used for earlier parameter fitting, but one current signal was discussed in chat. The old historical data underwent repeated selection and cannot serve as independent proof. No parameter re-selection from the fresh outcomes. No live code, settings or orders changed.

primaryFreshVerdict.reason: Fewer than 30 resolved setups; descriptive check only, not established performance.
